tools.name: architecture_overview
tools.description: Retrieve pre-computed architectural summaries. scope: 'root' for repo summary, a directory path, or a file path.

tools.name: context_pack
tools.description: Budget-pack the most relevant code + episodic context into a token-bounded block ready for injection into the next prompt. Call this BEFORE reading any source file to avoid wasting tokens on raw file reads. Returns at most max_tokens (default 2000) tokens — much smaller than raw files. Do NOT call for known short files (< 50 lines) — use Read directly instead.

tools.name: cross_repo_search
tools.description: Search knowledge from sibling repositories.

tools.name: cross_repo_traverse
tools.description: Traverse the org dependency graph from a repo or symbol to find cross-service relationships.

tools.name: dependency_graph
tools.description: Return import/dependency relationships for a module. direction: "imports" | "imported_by" | "both". depth: transitive traversal depth (1 = direct only).

tools.name: episodic_search
tools.description: Return past episodic events matching a keyword query.

tools.name: explain_change
tools.description: Explain what changed in a file or function recently by cross-referencing git history with episodic memory events mentioning the same target.

tools.name: find_symbol_path
tools.description: Find the shortest call-graph path between two symbols, crossing service boundaries via the org graph when needed.

tools.name: get_agent_bootstrap
tools.description: Single-call session bootstrap for AI agents. Replaces the 4-call sequence (get_session_brief → get_last_context → get_user_profile → get_error_patterns) with one ~300-token payload.

tools.name: get_error_patterns
tools.description: Return recurring error patterns with prevention hints to avoid repeating mistakes.

tools.name: get_last_context
tools.description: Return the most recent context snapshot written by context_pack.

tools.name: get_service_endpoints
tools.description: Return the HTTP endpoint registry for a service (from endpoints.json).

tools.name: get_session_brief
tools.description: Generate a session bootstrap brief for agent orientation.

tools.name: get_session_history
tools.description: Return recent conversation session exchanges for context continuity.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Return the user's interaction style profile for Claude to adapt its responses.

tools.name: graph_stats
tools.description: Return a health summary of the current graph state.

tools.name: link_repos
tools.description: Record a dependency relationship between two repos in the org graph. Call this when you discover that one repo imports from or calls another.

tools.name: list_org_context
tools.description: Show what org, project, and sibling repositories the current repo belongs to.

tools.name: log_episode
tools.description: Log a structured episodic event to the episodic memory store. Use to record what happened: bugs found, code explored, agent actions. Retrievable via episodic_search in future sessions. Do NOT use for architectural decisions — use record_decision instead.

tools.name: lookup_symbol
tools.description: Return all locations where a symbol is defined or called, with file, line, and type. If include_org=True, also searches sibling repositories in the same organization. Do NOT call for broad concepts — only exact or near-exact symbol names. For concept queries use semantic_search_code instead.

tools.name: org_dependencies
tools.description: Return the bidirectional inter-repo dependency graph for the current organization.

tools.name: org_search
tools.description: FALLBACK ONLY — use org_wide_search first. Text-match search across org repos when org_wide_search returns nothing. Do NOT call as primary cross-repo search — org_wide_search has broader coverage.

tools.name: org_wide_search
tools.description: PRIMARY tool for cross-repo queries. Searches memories across ALL registered repos. Use this by default when a query spans multiple services or the answer may live in any repo. Prefer this over org_search (legacy fallback).

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record an architectural decision, bug fix rationale, or 'why we did X'. Stored in episodic memory — retrievable via episodic_search in future sessions. Call when a non-obvious architectural decision is made, a bug root-cause is understood, or the user says to 'remember' something. Do NOT call for routine changes — only decisions where WHY is non-obvious. Returns: {stored: True, searchable_via: 'episodic_search'}

tools.name: record_error
tools.description: Record an error Claude or the user encountered so future sessions can avoid it.

tools.name: record_user_preference
tools.description: Store an explicit user preference or query-rewrite correction.

tools.name: retrieve_memory
tools.description: Retrieve the top-k memories most similar to the query. If include_org=True, also queries sibling repositories in the same organization.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search indexed documentation files (*.md, *.rst, *.txt) by semantic similarity. Use for: README explanations, architecture docs, decision logs. Do NOT use for code — use semantic_search_code instead.

tools.name: search_token
tools.description: Word-level reverse-index search.

tools.name: semantic_search_code
tools.description: Semantic vector search over indexed code symbols only (no episodic memory mixed in). Optionally filter by language: "python", "typescript", "go", etc. Do NOT call for exact string matches — use search_token or grep instead. Use for concepts and natural-language queries about what code does.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store a semantic memory with an optional source label.

tools.name: subgraph
tools.description: Return the local neighbourhood of a concept or symbol as {nodes, edges}.

tools.name: supersede_learning
tools.description: Deprecate an existing memory (by ID from store_memory conflicts list) and replace it with corrected text. Use when store_memory returns a conflict that contains incorrect or outdated information.

tools.name: who_calls
tools.description: Return every caller of a function across the indexed repo.
